headline: NUS Researchers Develop Washable Electronic Touchscreen Garment
summary: Researchers at the National University of Singapore developed a washable electronic touchscreen sleeve that displays images, responds to finger touches, and measures body temperature after 50 machine wash cycles.
why: Smart textiles and wearable electronics represent an emerging hardware segment with potential applications across remote healthcare monitoring, military, and consumer devices.
